meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为视频中的人声与配乐做混音:淡入淡出、交叉过渡、音量自动化、人声压过配乐、效果链与分组总控。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频里已有旁白和背景音乐,却总在互相打架。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your voiceover and music track keep fighting each other in the same video.

howto.what: 给已放进 HyperFrames 合成里的音频做混音：靠 data-fx-chain、data-automation、data-fx-carve 三个属性实现淡入淡出、增益、音量自动化、人声闪避、效果链和多轨 submix 总线。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成里已经放好音频、需要给它混音时接管，比如做淡入淡出、闪避或效果链。找 BGM、音效等素材或排片段时交给别的技能。

say.text: 给配乐轨加上 voiceover carve，按人声让路
say.note: 写入 data-fx-carve，自动生成闪避包络

say.text: 给这段音频加 2 秒淡入、结尾 3 秒淡出
say.note: 在已放置的音轨上写入淡入淡出包络

say.text: 把人声和配乐放进同一个 hf-audio-group 总线
say.note: 一条总线带链、推子和自动化时钟

howto.what_en: Claude mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition by writing data-fx-chain, data-automation and data-fx-carve: fades, gain, volume automation, voiceover carve ducking, effect chains and submix buses.
howto.when_en: Triggers when audio is already placed in a HyperFrames composition and needs mixing, e.g. fades, ducking or an effect chain. Sourcing BGM/SFX or arranging clips belongs to other skills.

say_en.text: Add a voiceover carve to the music bed so it yields to the voice
Give this clip a 2-second fade-in and a 3-second fade-out
say_en.note: Writes fade envelopes on the placed track

say_en.text: Put the voice and music on one hf-audio-group bus
say_en.note: One bus carrying a chain, fader and automation clock
